claim: When a tool door gains new error reason codes, extend every closed reason vocabulary between it and the model in the same change, because a relay that normalizes unrecognized reasons back to unknown erases the protocol-vs-handler distinction the codes were added for.
because: lens-scan execute r-20261014192943-c5dd: a page-bridge fix coded unknown_tool/invalid_arguments/tool_error at the inject door, but the gate and the desktop relay map any reason outside their closed list to unknown, so a re-judge still found the two error channels indistinguishable and the change was reverted.
